component.name: P.A.W. — Personal Agent Workspace
component.summary: Local-first spatial workspace for guarded agent workflows

description.p: P.A.W. is a desktop workspace for inspecting a spatial city view, organizing typed workflows, and reviewing execution history and approval records. The application is designed to keep workspace data and provider credentials on the local device.

The current early-development build supports deterministic local workflow nodes, run controls, persistent approval records, workspace snapshots, and optional Groq chat. Model-driven autonomous execution and external tool adapters are not yet available. The browser preview does not have access to desktop capabilities.
